title: 微型隧道機頂管
summary: 本課以微型隧道的面壓、泥水輸送與管節受力為主線，從面壓合力與地下水邊界與泥漿濃度與固體平衡建立系統邊界，再把接頭傳力與墊材接觸、泥水管路損失與流變連到成品管線水密與紀錄。泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on microtunnel face pressure, slurry transport and pipe loading. It begins with Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary and Slurry concentration and solids balance, links Joint load transfer and packer contact and Slurry-line loss and rheology, and ends with Finished-pipeline tightness and records. Slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「面壓合力與地下水邊界」與「泥漿濃度與固體平衡」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary" and "Slurry concentration and solids balance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 面壓合力與地下水邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「面壓合力與地下水邊界」如何影響微型隧道機頂管的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Microtunneling pipe jacking”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 泥水面壓需與土骨架及孔隙水的穩定條件共同評估，壓力乘圓面積只是作用合力。高程差使掌子面上下水壓不同，局部滲透又影響有效應力；不能將這個合力當成面前土體所需支護的完整判準。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將艙壓感測高程、地下水頭及地層剖面對應；若出現使用不同高程壓力直接比較，誤判面前支護裕度，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「面壓合力與地下水邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Slurry face pressure must be assessed with soil-skeleton and pore-water stability; pressure times circular area is only a resultant. Elevation creates vertical pressure variation and seepage changes effective stress. This resultant alone does not establish the support needed for the ground ahead of the machine. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Relate chamber-pressure sensor elevation to groundwater head and ground profile. If comparing pressures at different elevations directly misjudges face-support margin, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：uniformResultant=250 kPa*pi*(1.5 m)^2/4=441.8 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: uniformResultant=250 kPa*pi*(1.5 m)^2/4=441.8 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泥水壓力乘面積就是完整的掌子面穩定驗算」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Slurry pressure times area constitutes a complete face-stability verification" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「面壓合力與地下水邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「微型隧道機頂管」的「面壓合力與地下水邊界：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出地層、地下水、開挖邊界與支撐的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「都會地下工區協調」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與地質假設、監測位置、時間順序及基準點版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary: mechanism and system paths” in “Microtunneling pipe jacking”. Draw the ground, groundwater, excavation boundary and support interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Urban underground coordination” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ground assumptions, monitoring locations, time order and benchmark version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「面壓合力與地下水邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary" is correct?
options: 泥水壓力乘面積就是完整的掌子面穩定驗算
泥水面壓需與土骨架及孔隙水的穩定條件共同評估，壓力乘圓面積只是作用合力。
回流所有固體都一定是這一時段新挖出的土
optionsEn: Slurry pressure times area constitutes a complete face-stability verification
Slurry face pressure must be assessed with soil-skeleton and pore-water stability; pressure times circular area is only a resultant.
Every solid in the return flow was newly excavated during that interval
quiz.explanation: 泥水面壓需與土骨架及孔隙水的穩定條件共同評估，壓力乘圓面積只是作用合力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Slurry face pressure must be assessed with soil-skeleton and pore-water stability; pressure times circular area is only a resultant. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 面壓合力與地下水邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「面壓合力與地下水邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：uniformResultant=250 kPa*pi*(1.5 m)^2/4=441.8 kN。泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: uniformResultant=250 kPa*pi*(1.5 m)^2/4=441.8 kN. Slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將艙壓感測高程、地下水頭及地層剖面對應。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Relate chamber-pressure sensor elevation to groundwater head and ground profile.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「面壓合力與地下水邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary", which statement holds?
options: 把總推力除以全管外表面就得到真實均勻摩阻
雷射讀值穩定就能證明整條管線高程沒有偏差

optionsEn: Dividing total thrust by pipe surface yields the true uniform skin friction
Stable laser readings prove the entire pipeline elevation has no bias
Original teaching assumptions: uniformResultant=250 kPa*pi*(1.5 m)^2/4=441.8 kN.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：uniformResultant=250 kPa*pi*(1.5 m)^2/4=441.8 kN。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 面壓合力與地下水邊界：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「面壓合力與地下水邊界」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將艙壓感測高程、地下水頭及地層剖面對應。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「使用不同高程壓力直接比較，誤判面前支護裕度」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Relate chamber-pressure sensor elevation to groundwater head and ground profile. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Comparing pressures at different elevations directly misjudges face-support margin. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將艙壓感測高程、地下水頭及地層剖面對應列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現使用不同高程壓力直接比較，誤判面前支護裕度，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Relate chamber-pressure sensor elevation to groundwater head and ground profile. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If comparing pressures at different elevations directly misjudges face-support margin, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：使用不同高程壓力直接比較，誤判面前支護裕度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Comparing pressures at different elevations directly misjudges face-support margin. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將艙壓感測高程、地下水頭及地層剖面對應。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「使用不同高程壓力直接比較，誤判面前支護裕度」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Relate chamber-pressure sensor elevation to groundwater head and ground profile. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Comparing pressures at different elevations directly misjudges face-support margin. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將將艙壓感測高程、地下水頭及地層剖面對應列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現使用不同高程壓力直接比較，誤判面前支護裕度，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Relate chamber-pressure sensor elevation to groundwater head and ground profile. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If comparing pressures at different elevations directly misjudges face-support margin, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「面壓合力與地下水邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary"?
options: 將艙壓感測高程、地下水頭及地層剖面對應。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
單一最大沉陷讀值足以唯一決定完整沉陷槽形
optionsEn: Relate chamber-pressure sensor elevation to groundwater head and ground profile.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
One maximum-settlement reading uniquely determines the complete trough shape
quiz.explanation: 將艙壓感測高程、地下水頭及地層剖面對應。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Relate chamber-pressure sensor elevation to groundwater head and ground profile. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 面壓合力與地下水邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「面壓合力與地下水邊界」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 使用不同高程壓力直接比較，誤判面前支護裕度。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將艙壓感測高程、地下水頭及地層剖面對應，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Comparing pressures at different elevations directly misjudges face-support margin. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to relate chamber-pressure sensor elevation to groundwater head and ground profile to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將艙壓感測高程、地下水頭及地層剖面對應；若出現使用不同高程壓力直接比較，誤判面前支護裕度，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If comparing pressures at different elevations directly misjudges face-support margin, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「泥水壓力乘面積就是完整的掌子面穩定驗算」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Slurry pressure times area constitutes a complete face-stability verification" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 使用不同高程壓力直接比較，誤判面前支護裕度。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將艙壓感測高程、地下水頭及地層剖面對應，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Comparing pressures at different elevations directly misjudges face-support margin. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to relate chamber-pressure sensor elevation to groundwater head and ground profile to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「面壓合力與地下水邊界」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Face-pressure resultant and groundwater boundary" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
使用不同高程壓力直接比較，誤判面前支護裕度。
回流所有固體都一定是這一時段新挖出的土
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Comparing pressures at different elevations directly misjudges face-support margin.
Every solid in the return flow was newly excavated during that interval
quiz.explanation: 使用不同高程壓力直接比較，誤判面前支護裕度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Comparing pressures at different elevations directly misjudges face-support margin. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 泥漿濃度與固體平衡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Slurry concentration and solids balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「泥漿濃度與固體平衡」如何影響微型隧道機頂管的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Slurry concentration and solids balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Microtunneling pipe jacking”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 回流密度同時受輸入載液、挖出固體及混入水影響，需用兩相質量體積平衡估固體濃度。輸入載液若已有固體就不能把全部回流固體當新增出土；沉積與密度計偏差也會使瞬時資料不能閉合長時段土量。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步比較進回流密度、流量與分離固體質量；若出現循環載液原有固體被重複計為出土，造成虛假超挖警訊，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「泥漿濃度與固體平衡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Return density depends on carrier fluid, excavated solids and incoming water, requiring two-phase balance. Solids already present in the feed cannot be counted as newly excavated ground. Deposition and density-meter bias further prevent instantaneous readings from closing a long-period excavation balance. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare synchronized feed and return density, flow and separated-solids mass. If recirculated carrier solids are counted again as excavation and create a false overbreak signal, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Slurry concentration and solids balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Inputs densities rhoMix=1300, rhoCarrier=1100, rhoSolid=2650 kg/m3; Cv=(rhoMix-rhoCarrier)/(rhoSolid-rhoCarrier)=(1300-1100)/(2650-1100)=0.1290; Qs=0.050 m3/s*Cv=0.00645 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs densities rhoMix=1300, rhoCarrier=1100, rhoSolid=2650 kg/m3; Cv=(rhoMix-rhoCarrier)/(rhoSolid-rhoCarrier)=(1300-1100)/(2650-1100)=0.1290; Qs=0.050 m3/s*Cv=0.00645 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「回流所有固體都一定是這一時段新挖出的土」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every solid in the return flow was newly excavated during that interval" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「泥漿濃度與固體平衡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Slurry concentration and solids balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 泥漿濃度與固體平衡
knowledge.text: 回流密度同時受輸入載液、挖出固體及混入水影響，需用兩相質量體積平衡估固體濃度。輸入載液若已有固體就不能把全部回流固體當新增出土；沉積與密度計偏差也會使瞬時資料不能閉合長時段土量。
knowledge.textEn: Return density depends on carrier fluid, excavated solids and incoming water, requiring two-phase balance. Solids already present in the feed cannot be counted as newly excavated ground.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：回流所有固體都一定是這一時段新挖出的土 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every solid in the return flow was newly excavated during that interval Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「泥漿濃度與固體平衡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 回流所有固體都一定是這一時段新挖出的土
成品管內徑可以直接用來計算刀盤開挖體積

optionsEn: Every solid in the return flow was newly excavated during that interval
Finished pipe internal diameter directly gives the cutter excavation volume
Return density depends on carrier fluid, excavated solids and incoming water, requiring two-phase balance.
quiz.explanation: 回流密度同時受輸入載液、挖出固體及混入水影響，需用兩相質量體積平衡估固體濃度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Return density depends on carrier fluid, excavated solids and incoming water, requiring two-phase balance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 泥漿濃度與固體平衡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Slurry concentration and solids balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「泥漿濃度與固體平衡」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Slurry concentration and solids balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Inputs densities rhoMix=1300, rhoCarrier=1100, rhoSolid=2650 kg/m3; Cv=(rhoMix-rhoCarrier)/(rhoSolid-rhoCarrier)=(1300-1100)/(2650-1100)=0.1290; Qs=0.050 m3/s*Cv=0.00645 m3/s。泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs densities rhoMix=1300, rhoCarrier=1100, rhoSolid=2650 kg/m3; Cv=(rhoMix-rhoCarrier)/(rhoSolid-rhoCarrier)=(1300-1100)/(2650-1100)=0.1290; Qs=0.050 m3/s*Cv=0.00645 m3/s. Slurry pressure, ground stress and pipe structure use distinct boundaries; simplified hydraulics and average bearing cannot directly set equipment parameters. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步比較進回流密度、流量與分離固體質量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare synchronized feed and return density, flow and separated-solids mass.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Inputs densities rhoMix=1300, rhoCarrier=1100, rhoSolid=2650 kg/m3; Cv=(rhoMix-rhoCarrier)/(rhoSolid-rhoCarrier)=(1300-1100)/(2650-1100)=0.1290; Qs=0.050 m3/s*Cv=0.00645 m3/s。泥水壓力、土體應力和管節結構採不同邊界；簡化水力及平均承壓均不能直接設定設備參數。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs densities rhoMix=1300, rhoCarrier=1100, rhoSolid=2650 kg/m3; Cv=(rhoMix-rhoCarrier)/(rhoSolid-rhoCarrier)=(1300-1100)/(2650-1100)=0.1290; Qs=0.050 m3/s*Cv=0.00645 m3/s. knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「泥漿濃度與固體平衡」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

總推力低於管節額定值就不需檢查接頭接觸

Thrust below the pipe rating eliminates the need to inspect joint contact
Pump discharge pressure always equals slurry pressure at the excavation face

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs densities rhoMix=1300, rhoCarrier=1100, rhoSolid=2650 kg/m3; Cv=(rhoMix-rhoCarrier)/(rhoSolid-rhoCarrier)=(1300-1100)/(2650-1100)=0.1290; Qs=0.050 m3/s*Cv=0.00645 m3/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 泥漿濃度與固體平衡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Slurry concentration and solids balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「泥漿濃度與固體平衡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Slurry concentration and solids balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步比較進回流密度、流量與分離固體質量。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「循環載液原有固體被重複計為出土，造成虛假超挖警訊」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare synchronized feed and return density, flow and separated-solids mass. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Recirculated carrier solids are counted again as excavation and create a false overbreak signal. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將同步比較進回流密度、流量與分離固體質量列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現循環載液原有固體被重複計為出土，造成虛假超挖警訊，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare synchronized feed and return density, flow and separated-solids mass. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If recirculated carrier solids are counted again as excavation and create a false overbreak signal, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：循環載液原有固體被重複計為出土，造成虛假超挖警訊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Recirculated carrier solids are counted again as excavation and create a false overbreak signal. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步比較進回流密度、流量與分離固體質量。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「循環載液原有固體被重複計為出土，造成虛假超挖警訊」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare synchronized feed and return density, flow and separated-solids mass. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Recirculated carrier solids are counted again as excavation and create a false overbreak signal. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將同步比較進回流密度、流量與分離固體質量列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現循環載液原有固體被重複計為出土，造成虛假超挖警訊，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare synchronized feed and return density, flow and separated-solids mass. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If recirculated carrier solids are counted again as excavation and create a false overbreak signal, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「泥漿濃度與固體平衡」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Slurry concentration and solids balance"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。

Compare synchronized feed and return density, flow and separated-solids mass.
Groundwater risk automatically disappears once the machine reaches the receiving shaft

quiz.explanationEn: Compare synchronized feed and return density, flow and separated-solids mass. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 泥漿濃度與固體平衡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Slurry concentration and solids balance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「泥漿濃度與固體平衡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Slurry concentration and solids balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 循環載液原有固體被重複計為出土，造成虛假超挖警訊。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到同步比較進回流密度、流量與分離固體質量，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Recirculated carrier solids are counted again as excavation and create a false overbreak signal. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare synchronized feed and return density, flow and separated-solids mass to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察同步比較進回流密度、流量與分離固體質量；若出現循環載液原有固體被重複計為出土，造成虛假超挖警訊，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If recirculated carrier solids are counted again as excavation and create a false overbreak signal, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「回流所有固體都一定是這一時段新挖出的土」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every solid in the return flow was newly excavated during that interval" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「泥漿濃度與固體平衡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Slurry concentration and solids balance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
成品管內徑可以直接用來計算刀盤開挖體積
循環載液原有固體被重複計為出土，造成虛假超挖警訊。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Finished pipe internal diameter directly gives the cutter excavation volume
Recirculated carrier solids are counted again as excavation and create a false overbreak signal.
quiz.explanation: 循環載液原有固體被重複計為出土，造成虛假超挖警訊。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Recirculated carrier solids are counted again as excavation and create a false overbreak signal. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
